correctness.rationale: On v(u²−4v)(1+u+v)≠0, the degree-ten defining polynomial is squarefree. The two degree-two involution quotient Jacobians become isomorphic genus-two factors under explicit Möbius coordinates and yield a prime-to-five isogeny to a square. Exact Cartier entries give matrix [[A,4ab],[2,2a+1]] and det P; rank-one semilinear iteration vanishes exactly when A^5+2a+1=0. Elimination gives H of degree fifteen, tested squarefree, with all its roots in smooth locus, and an irreducible degree-fourteen factor. The pure Python exact checker successfully reproduced those certificates and independent projective counts. The ordinary, intermediate and supersingular Newton slopes follow by dimension-two classification and are duplicated under prime-to-5 isogeny. No finite experiment is claimed to prove an infinite result.

value.rationale: The fifteen-point reduced supersingular locus, 1+14 Frobenius orbit, and complete Newton strata isolate natural arithmetic specializations inside the exceptional square-Jacobian genus-four family. The 14-degree extension field phenomenon is invisible from the formerly known nonordinary divisor and F5 parameter, and precisely answers the geometric finite-locus/field-of-definition question with a reusable exact polynomial certificate. This is an intrinsic natural classification, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice or mere substitution.
